points.text: Tools: screenshots can be read locally with Tesseract, with confidence, estimated letter height, contrast and expected-text matching. Shot flows can check known labels without a vision call.

Tools: isolated screenshot reviewers now receive crop, zoom, image-difference and OCR helpers plus the available full-size source images. Text questions try local OCR first; visual reviews stay available without OCR. Failed or unavailable OCR is recorded so a reviewer can fall back honestly, and an explicit exception is kept in the review summary.

Tools: the text-review hook now runs inside staged reviews instead of skipping them. Attempts expire after 30 minutes and are tied to image contents; no guessed OCR tool names or host permission bypasses. Local helper permissions reject shell substitution and redirection, including inside output filenames. The portable helper reuses the existing RESULT formatter, and the JSON hook has a separate hook entry. Media runners receive the same helpers and available originals without changing their generation permissions.

Tools: split the performance-sweep runner into smaller rendering, journey and scoring helpers without changing the benchmark. Fixed the split tool to retain signal callback delegates and mark unused host parameters.
Tools: split hitch-row formatting, timing and output into small helpers, retaining the existing log state and row contents.
Refactor: moved actor light placement and slot updates into smaller helpers, keeping the same shading calculations and public API.
Tools: split hitch-log session and tick handling into smaller files, keeping the existing counters, state and log lifecycle.
Refactor: moved sole-image scanning into a small sibling helper without changing the scan or baked table format.

Tools: the benchmarks share their repeated setup, visibility sampling, percentile and report routines. Hitch timing fields use one ordered table; the reported values, rounding and report text stay the same.
Docs: corrected the Debug source map and replaced a dead example image path with an instruction to use the actual temporary file.

Tools: long status summaries now stay within the console budget while retaining the source failure result. Full details remain in the log and with the documented `--verbose` option; a selftest checks both views.

Clips: portrait montages crop each segment before drawing callout/title chips, keep end cards at native size and centre chip titles on tall canvases, including 4:5. Export/fit/montage accept focus/track/box fill with source boxes; chip placement keeps clear of its subject. Named movie regions stay scoped to the selected movie on each segment; tests cover all three fill modes and centred 4:5 title pixels. Tracking and image resizing keep their existing helper owners.

Clips: tracked callout labels no longer avoid their own previous frame or flicker between slots. Distinct owners, half-open windows, sticky slots, a short safe hold, eased movement and edge clamping keep labels steady and separate.

Tools: loading-bar traces now close their local server socket/thread and browser on failed imports, setup or runs, and remove console listeners on navigation errors. Failure-injection tests exercise the cleanup without launching a browser or game.

Docs: reconciled the busy-fight repeat with the existing continuous perf sweep, checked current main and the subsequent shader/event-driven/HUD changes, and retired the stale standalone repeat. Historical scores are not current-code acceptance; the remaining desktop/two-cold-web evidence gap stays explicit, without substitute software-renderer scores or duplicate runs.

Relay: prepared the supported structured email binding, escaped HTML/plain-text sender and acceptance/error handling, with generated-type, mock outbox and upload-free build checks. Mail stays off with no chosen sender or deployment. Arbitrary-recipient sending needs Workers Paid and conflicts with the relay's free-only decision; activation is blocked pending an owner decision and service/domain verification.

Clips: comparison wipes now keep clean-source recipes. Native portrait/4:5 reconstructs both clean legs before drawing BEFORE/AFTER identity chips, keeps those chips inside the canvas, reserves their space and draws identity last so even a crowded callout cannot cover it. Legacy baked clips accept explicit recipes instead of guessed source/timing; regression tests use baked comparison inputs, trims and multi-segment exports.

Tools: removed unnecessary protected-hook edits. The review entry now ships from the existing tools owner, while the repository-wide hook is restored byte-for-byte to baseline. Automatic Tesseract prepasses and the actual staged PreToolUse evidence gate remain; missing staged policy fails closed. No allowlist or host permissions changed.

Tools: replaced disabled Cloudflare Paid mail prep with the selected Resend HTTPS adapter. Outbox identities provide stable idempotency; bounded requests preserve plain text and opt-out behavior, failures stay queued. Both deploy payload modes now retain independently provisioned secrets. Mock acceptance, quota/error, generated-type and secret-retention tests do not claim a live send.

Tools: removed the repository GitHub bot-gate workflow at the User's request. Local proof, script caps, scope files and review/platform safety controls are unchanged; unrelated workflows are retained. Required-status settings could not be inspected with the current token (HTTP 403), so no repository protection settings were altered.

Refactor: restored actor-light `_biased` facade delegation for the existing shadow matrix debug caller. The full proof exposed this extraction regression; the moved calculation is unchanged. Runtime revalidation remains part of the final batch proof.

Tools: activated the user-approved Resend relay after a sending-off deployment and a fresh empty-outbox/no-reports check. Source configuration now matches live sending-on state. This does not claim test delivery: the existing secure webhook transforms test subjects/bodies, and no new public send endpoint was added.

Tools: kept comparison identity/title bands protected even when an oversized tracked subject leaves no fully disjoint chip position. Free-band fallback anchors no longer chase a new edge and snap across the 4:5 frame. Added the exact grass-callout geometry regression; normal slot easing and owner-window tests remain.

Refactor: included the extracted sole-scan helper in both bake fingerprints and added a mutation regression. The old sole stamp matched baseline exactly but our split changed its inputs; a normal sanctioned sole rebake is still required, not a manually copied hash or weakened check.

Tools: nightly selftests now install their declared FFmpeg/display dependencies and use the existing pinned Godot setup before running the unchanged full suite (issue #75). No failure filters, skips or relaxed assertions were added. Hosted execution and the independent tuner/platform failure remain unverified.

Tools: documented the official descriptive application-client requirement for managed workers.dev and distinguished edge Error 1010 from the subsequent live relay GitHub401. Configuration health is not claimed as end-to-end delivery; no browser disguise, security setting change or credential extraction was used.

Tools: removed the earlier global-hook OCR claim after restoring that hook; staged review documentation remains authoritative. Condensed retirement wording back under the unchanged boot-file budget, without changing local proof, scope or size limits.
Finished task female-voxel-walk-proof: Female voxel walk proof (external voxelizer).

Tools: deploy payload secret mode now preserves independently provisioned GitHub credentials even when an old legacy environment variable is present. Rotation requires a separate explicit flag and nonempty source; fixture tests cover default preservation, intentional replacement and missing-input failure without reading real secrets.

Tools: existing relay health reports only boolean GitHub credential type, whitespace and PAT-shape checks to distinguish malformed installed configuration from upstream authorization failures, without values, lengths, hashes, outbound probes or a new endpoint. Fixture-only regression verifies no credential serialization.

Tools: relay outbox now preserves sanitized attempt stage/error/HTTP status and provider acceptance ID privately. Shared atomic existing-row dispatch freezes sender/payload and stable idempotency; a default-disabled platform scheduled handler consumes one singleton operator authorization before a bounded retry, rechecks opt-in and refuses expired/sent/in-flight rows. Additive migration and mock failure/concurrency/privacy tests cover recovery without a public send endpoint or backlog drain.

Tools: the authorized relay diagnostic attempt exposed our unsupported Workers `redirect:error` option (TypeError before network). Use supported `manual`, still reject every redirect without forwarding credentials, and add a real local Workerd adapter-construction regression with fake requests only. No extra live send is implied by this correction.

Tools: live relay recovery verified end-to-end on the same queued message and idempotency key: secure report, owner comment, signed webhook, durable provider acceptance and Resend delivered status. Exactly one provider email; temporary Cron removed and permit consumed. Delivery is mail-server acceptance, not an inbox-placement claim.
